status_semantics.implemented_unverified: source exists but required software evidence is incomplete
status_semantics.accepted_software: required automated software gates and independent code review passed
status_semantics.blocked_dependency: requires a separately accepted software or security prerequisite
status_semantics.blocked_hardware: requires evidence from the specified physical devices
status_semantics.accepted_hardware: real device evidence was captured and independently reviewed

tasks.title: Decode recorded FromRadio text as an unverified observation
acceptance: Bounded recorded-capture parser only; no serial open, network, persistence or ToRadio path
Decode only FromRadio.packet -> MeshPacket.decoded -> Data(TEXT_MESSAGE_APP)
fixed32 from/to, uint32 channel, valid field-number range and FromRadio oneof conflicts are checked
Output remains unverified and never enters Messenger/PACE state or creates a delivery receipt
Malformed, duplicate, oversized, unsupported, invalid UTF-8 and bidi/control cases are covered

evidence.local_gates: workspace fmt, warnings-denied Clippy, full locked tests, Rust 1.90 check, catalog/security validators passed; one unrelated dashboard test was transiently flaky on the first full run and passed in a repeat run
evidence.fixture: Synthetic bytes match protoc encoding using a minimal schema aligned to the pinned field types; not generated from upstream bindings and not a hardware capture
evidence.independent_review: No remaining actionable parser defects reported after fixes

tasks.title: Implement OS-enforced receive-only USB broker authorization
acceptance: Deny-by-default device selection and receive-only scope enforced outside UI
Missing, stale, wrong-device, revoked and denied grants cause zero USB I/O
Close on revoke, unplug and suspend; bound reads and cancellation
No automatic connection on app launch, package selection or capture inspection

tasks.title: Verify passive reception against owned Meshtastic radios
acceptance: Record intended Mac and Raspberry Pi 5, two owned radios, model, firmware, USB identity and region
Capture actual FromRadio frames and independently decode using the pinned schema
Evidence proves zero host-to-radio bytes, reset/config changes or application transmission
Record unplug, suspend, malformed-frame and cleanup behavior with an independent reviewer

tasks.title: Design a separately authorized Meshtastic transmit contract
acceptance: Independent protocol and security review before any transmit implementation
Explicit one-operation confirmation, device-bound grant and regional airtime constraints
Interrupted sends report UNKNOWN OUTCOME absent an independent receipt
No claim of delivery/read status from radio transmission alone

tasks.title: Specify the OS-enforced LAN receive scope for WisMesh Station
acceptance: Define the receive-only scope separately from serial.read, network.fetch and mesh.transmit
Specify endpoint/protocol/port binding, deadline, bounded buffers, cancellation, revocation and credential handling
If MQTT is selected, explicitly scope CONNECT/SUBSCRIBE/keepalive control frames, require read-only topic ACLs and forbid publish operations
Require policy denial before socket creation and no connection from browse, select or module viewing
Design only; no socket, station or radio I/O, and no claim that the OS-enforced broker is implemented

tasks.title: Integrate and verify passive LAN reception from WisMesh Station
blocking_conditions: OS-enforced network receive broker implementation and independent security review are not complete
acceptance: Identify the actual station model, firmware, explicitly selected endpoint and enabled LAN service without network discovery
Review TCP client startup side effects before claiming receive-only; standard Meshtastic client initialization may request configuration and send heartbeats
Use a separately authorized passive data source; if MQTT is used, scope CONNECT/SUBSCRIBE/keepalive control frames and enforce read-only broker ACLs, with no publish operations
Do not change station, radio, MQTT or mesh configuration implicitly; never write Meshtastic ToRadio configuration/packet frames or transmit RF
Use the reviewed network scope with bounded framing, cancellation, revoke behavior and safe credential handling before live sockets
Keep decoded observations unverified; no Messenger/PACE receipt, persistence or radio transmit claim
